caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be an ornate vessel, possibly an ewer or tankard, rendered in grayscale with gold-colored accents. The main body of the vessel is bell-shaped, widening toward the base, and features decorative patterns including floral motifs and spirals intricately shaded in grey. The handle is large, rounded, and attached to the upper side of the vessel. The vessel is topped with a gold-colored lid, which has two thin vertical rods protruding from the center. A gold-colored chain is attached to the lid and connects to a gold key-like accessory hanging to the side of the vessel. The background is plain and uncolored, with the focus exclusively on the object itself.
